package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	LearningReadinessRequestSchema = "learning-readiness-request.v1"
	LearningReadinessSchema        = "learning-readiness.v1"
	StudentReadinessSnapshotSchema = "student-planning-readiness-snapshot.v1"
	LearningReadinessResolverV1    = "learning-readiness-resolver-v1"

	ReadinessScopePublishedGraph = "PUBLISHED_GRAPH_RESOLUTION"
	ReadinessContentNotCreated   = "NOT_CREATED"
)

type LearningReadinessResult string

const (
	LearningReadinessReady              LearningReadinessResult = "READY"
	LearningReadinessNotReady           LearningReadinessResult = "NOT_READY"
	LearningReadinessNeedsClarification LearningReadinessResult = "NEEDS_CLARIFICATION"
)

const (
	ReadinessReasonFoundationGraphResolved   = "FOUNDATION_GRAPH_RESOLVED"
	ReadinessReasonGoBackendGraphResolved    = "GO_BACKEND_GRAPH_RESOLVED"
	ReadinessReasonActivePathExists          = "ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS"
	ReadinessReasonStudentStateMissing       = "STUDENT_STATE_MISSING"
	ReadinessReasonLearningIntentMissing     = "LEARNING_INTENT_MISSING"
	ReadinessReasonProfileIncomplete         = "PROFILE_INCOMPLETE"
	ReadinessReasonDesiredStacksUnresolved   = "DESIRED_STACKS_UNRESOLVED"
	ReadinessReasonMultipleDesiredStacks     = "MULTIPLE_DESIRED_STACKS"
	ReadinessReasonProfileContradictory      = "PROFILE_CONTRADICTORY"
	ReadinessReasonContentLanguageUntrusted  = "CONTENT_LANGUAGE_UNTRUSTED"
	ReadinessReasonProfileUnsupported        = "PROFILE_COMBINATION_UNSUPPORTED"
	ReadinessReasonPublishedGraphUnavailable = "PUBLISHED_GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE"
)

const (
	StudentReadinessStateNone      = "none"
	StudentReadinessStateDraft     = "accepted_draft"
	StudentReadinessStateFinalized = "finalized_profile"

	StudentReadinessArrayAnswered   = "answered"
	StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered = "unanswered"
	StudentReadinessArrayUnresolved = "unresolved"
)

var readinessCodePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$`)

type StudentReadinessStateRef struct {
	Kind    string `json:"kind"`
	Version int64  `json:"version"`
}

type LearningReadinessRequest struct {
	Schema           string                    `json:"schema"`
	ExpectedStateRef *StudentReadinessStateRef `json:"expected_state_ref,omitempty"`
}

type StudentReadinessStackValues struct {
	State         string   `json:"state"`
	Values        []string `json:"-"`
	ValuesPresent bool     `json:"-"`
}

// MarshalJSON preserves the semantic difference between an answered empty
// array and an unanswered/unknown value.  A plain omitempty slice loses that
// distinction and makes a durable readiness snapshot impossible to replay.
func (input StudentReadinessStackValues) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	if !validReadinessStacks(input) {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.State == StudentReadinessArrayAnswered {
		return json.Marshal(struct {
			State  string   `json:"state"`
			Values []string `json:"values"`
		}{State: input.State, Values: input.Values})
	}
	return json.Marshal(struct {
		State string `json:"state"`
	}{State: input.State})
}

func (input *StudentReadinessStackValues) UnmarshalJSON(raw []byte) error {
	var wire struct {
		State  string          `json:"state"`
		Values json.RawMessage `json:"values"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&wire); err != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	result := StudentReadinessStackValues{State: wire.State, ValuesPresent: wire.Values != nil}
	if wire.Values != nil {
		if bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(wire.Values), []byte("null")) || json.Unmarshal(wire.Values, &result.Values) != nil || result.Values == nil {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if !validReadinessStacks(result) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	*input = result
	return nil
}

type StudentReadinessLanguage struct {
	Code       string `json:"code"`
	Provenance string `json:"provenance"`
	Source     string `json:"source,omitempty"`
}

type StudentReadinessProfile struct {
	DirectionCode          string                      `json:"direction_code,omitempty"`
	SelfAssessedExperience string                      `json:"self_assessed_experience,omitempty"`
	KnownStacks            StudentReadinessStackValues `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          StudentReadinessStackValues `json:"desired_stacks"`
	PreferredLanguage      *StudentReadinessLanguage   `json:"preferred_language,omitempty"`
	ContentLanguage        *StudentReadinessLanguage   `json:"content_language,omitempty"`
	WeeklyMinutes          *int                        `json:"weekly_minutes,omitempty"`
	PreferredPace          *string                     `json:"preferred_pace,omitempty"`
}

type StudentReadinessLearningIntent struct {
	Code       string `json:"code"`
	Source     string `json:"source"`
	Provenance string `json:"provenance"`
}

// StudentReadinessActivePath is an observational Student-owned reference. It
// must never be interpreted as authority to mutate or replace the path.
type StudentReadinessActivePath struct {
	LearningPathID string `json:"learning_path_id"`
	Version        int64  `json:"version"`
	CourseID       string `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode       string `json:"goal_code"`
	Status         string `json:"status"`
}

type StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot struct {
	Schema         string                          `json:"schema"`
	StudentID      string                          `json:"student_id"`
	StateRef       StudentReadinessStateRef        `json:"state_ref"`
	LearningIntent *StudentReadinessLearningIntent `json:"learning_intent,omitempty"`
	Profile        StudentReadinessProfile         `json:"profile"`
	ActivePath     *StudentReadinessActivePath     `json:"active_path,omitempty"`
}

type LearningReadinessGoal struct {
	Code         string `json:"code"`
	Version      string `json:"version"`
	GraphVersion string `json:"graph_version"`
}

type LearningReadiness struct {
	Schema          string                      `json:"schema"`
	Result          LearningReadinessResult     `json:"result"`
	ReasonCodes     []string                    `json:"reason_codes"`
	ResolverVersion string                      `json:"resolver_version"`
	StateRef        StudentReadinessStateRef    `json:"state_ref"`
	ReadinessScope  string                      `json:"readiness_scope"`
	Executable      bool                        `json:"executable"`
	ContentStatus   string                      `json:"content_status"`
	Goal            *LearningReadinessGoal      `json:"goal,omitempty"`
	ActivePath      *StudentReadinessActivePath `json:"active_path,omitempty"`
}

func NormalizeLearningReadinessRequest(input LearningReadinessRequest) (LearningReadinessRequest, error) {
	if input.Schema != LearningReadinessRequestSchema {
		return LearningReadinessRequest{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.ExpectedStateRef != nil && !validStudentReadinessStateRef(*input.ExpectedStateRef) {
		return LearningReadinessRequest{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func ValidLearningReadinessStudentID(input string) bool {
	return canonicalReadinessUUID(input)
}

func NormalizeStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(input StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot) (StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error) {
	if input.Schema != StudentReadinessSnapshotSchema || !canonicalReadinessUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validStudentReadinessStateRef(input.StateRef) ||
		!validReadinessStacks(input.Profile.KnownStacks) || !validReadinessStacks(input.Profile.DesiredStacks) ||
		!validOptionalReadinessCode(input.Profile.DirectionCode) || !validOptionalReadinessCode(input.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience) {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.LearningIntent != nil && !validReadinessIntent(*input.LearningIntent, input.StateRef) {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.LearningIntent == nil && input.StateRef.Kind == StudentReadinessStateNone {
		// This is the only state that proves there is no accepted onboarding fact.
	} else if input.StateRef.Kind == StudentReadinessStateNone {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if !validPreferredReadinessLanguage(input.Profile.PreferredLanguage) ||
		!validContentReadinessLanguage(input.Profile.ContentLanguage, input.Profile.PreferredLanguage) {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.Profile.PreferredPace != nil && !validExactReadinessCode(*input.Profile.PreferredPace) {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	if input.ActivePath != nil && !validStudentReadinessActivePath(*input.ActivePath) {
		return StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validStudentReadinessStateRef(input StudentReadinessStateRef) bool {
	switch input.Kind {
	case StudentReadinessStateNone:
		return input.Version == 0
	case StudentReadinessStateDraft, StudentReadinessStateFinalized:
		return input.Version >= 1
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validReadinessStacks(input StudentReadinessStackValues) bool {
	switch input.State {
	case StudentReadinessArrayAnswered:
		if !input.ValuesPresent || len(input.Values) > 20 {
			return false
		}
		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Values))
		for _, value := range input.Values {
			if !validExactReadinessCode(value) {
				return false
			}
			if _, duplicate := seen[value]; duplicate {
				return false
			}
			seen[value] = struct{}{}
		}
		return true
	case StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered, StudentReadinessArrayUnresolved:
		return !input.ValuesPresent && input.Values == nil
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validReadinessIntent(input StudentReadinessLearningIntent, state StudentReadinessStateRef) bool {
	if input.Code != "learn_programming" || input.Source != "onboarding_goal_code.v1" {
		return false
	}
	return state.Kind == StudentReadinessStateDraft && input.Provenance == "accepted_student_draft" ||
		state.Kind == StudentReadinessStateFinalized && input.Provenance == "finalized_profile"
}

func validPreferredReadinessLanguage(input *StudentReadinessLanguage) bool {
	if input == nil {
		return true
	}
	return validReadinessLanguageCode(input.Code) && input.Source == "" &&
		(input.Provenance == "explicit_ui" || input.Provenance == "explicit_text" || input.Provenance == "untrusted_persisted")
}

func validContentReadinessLanguage(input, preferred *StudentReadinessLanguage) bool {
	if input == nil {
		return true
	}
	return preferred != nil && validReadinessLanguageCode(input.Code) && input.Source == "preferred_language" &&
		(input.Provenance == "explicit_ui" || input.Provenance == "explicit_text") &&
		input.Code == preferred.Code && input.Provenance == preferred.Provenance
}

func validStudentReadinessActivePath(input StudentReadinessActivePath) bool {
	return canonicalReadinessUUID(input.LearningPathID) && input.Version >= 1 && canonicalReadinessUUID(input.CourseID) &&
		validExactReadinessCode(input.GoalCode) && input.Status == "ACTIVE"
}

func validOptionalReadinessCode(input string) bool {
	return input == "" || validExactReadinessCode(input)
}

func validExactReadinessCode(input string) bool {
	return strings.TrimSpace(input) == input && readinessCodePattern.MatchString(input)
}

func validReadinessLanguageCode(input string) bool {
	if len(input) < 2 || len(input) > 16 || strings.TrimSpace(input) != input {
		return false
	}
	for _, current := range input {
		if (current < 'a' || current > 'z') && current != '-' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func canonicalReadinessUUID(input string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(input)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == input
}
